verdict.line: You lose trades level 1-6 to Q stacks and the W stun combo, but win from level 9 onward once Sunfire and Searing Charge come online.

brief.thesis: K'Sante's Q (Ntofo Strikes) stacks to a shockwave pull every 2 hits on a 3.5s cooldown, so he can chain Q into W (Path Maker) for a knockback stun almost every other trade in the early levels. Ornn has no answer to that stun lockup until his own W (Bellows Breath) Brittle and E (Searing Charge) knockup come online with levels and cooldown reduction, which is why the 43.2% head-to-head over 44 games skews early-game losses that get clawed back late.

theirWindow.when: K'Sante has 1 Ntofo Strikes stack up
theirWindow.what: He is one Q away from the 2-stack shockwave pull into W (Path Maker) stun. Back off E (Footwork) range or trade from max Q range so the second stack never lands clean.

yourWindow.when: His W (Path Maker) and E (Footwork) are both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Walk up and force a trade with your own Q (Volcanic Rupture) into W (Bellows Breath) stacks. Without his dash or stun up he has no way to disengage or punish your melee range.

powerCurve.note: Q stacks and shockwave pull dominate short trades
W stun-knockback combo punishes any overextension
Brittle from W starts trading back damage
E knockup and Sunfire sustain take over
R elemental threatens kills he can't out-trade

start.why: Taken in 69.6% of games (50% win rate over 32 games); the bonus regen and reduced poke damage absorb his Q poke chain while you're still missing Brittle uptime.

boots.why: 79.6% pick rate; his Q and auto-attacks are physical, and the flat damage reduction specifically softens his repeated short-trade pokes.

core.why: First item in the most common path; the burn DPS punishes him for standing in range to land Q stacks.
Second item in the dominant build path; stacks more raw health and omnivamp so extended trades after level 9 favor you.
Completes the top build path (66.7% win rate over 3 games); the stacking resistances scale your late trades once R is live.

situational.when: he builds into heavy auto-attack damage and you need the grievous wounds and armor spike
his burst threat (All Out) is the main thing threatening your HP bar
his attack speed scaling from All Out stacks is outpacing your sustain

runes.keystoneWhy: Run in 25.5% of games as the top page (58.3% win rate); the proc heal directly offsets his Q poke pattern and rewards you for holding lane position rather than backing off.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is run in 83% of games; Teleport lets you reset off his early-level trade advantage and come back with full potions for the level 9+ window where you take over.

playing.title: Count his Q stacks before engaging
playing.detail: Ntofo Strikes is on a 3.5s cooldown, so if he's landed one recently he can chain to the 2-stack shockwave pull fast. Don't walk into melee range until that window passes.

playing.title: Hold E for his W dash
playing.detail: Path Maker knocks back and stuns on hit; if you bait it and sidestep, his 14-10s cooldown (lower at higher level) is down and you get a free Searing Charge window.

playing.title: Trade only when his W and E are down
playing.detail: Without Path Maker's stun or Footwork's dash-shield, K'Sante has no disengage from your melee range. This is your actual trade window, not just 'when he's low'.

playing.title: Don't contest until Brittle lands
playing.detail: Bellows Breath's final gout applies Brittle; your own damage output is weak until you've stacked W into a trade. Walk the breath fully through him before committing Q.

playing.title: Watch for All Out before level 6 kill attempts
playing.detail: R knocks back through walls and transforms his kit with increased damage and healing. Respect flash timing near walls once he's level 6 even if he looks low on resources.

playing.title: Use R to punish his No cooldowns
playing.detail: Call of the Forge God's elemental is best thrown when his W and E are both down, since he has no way to dash out of the knockup chain for the recast.

playing.title: Teleport back for the level 9 spike
playing.detail: If you lose early trades, don't force fights for CS. Reset, buy into Sunfire Aegis, and return with Teleport once your power curve flips around level 9.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the level-by-level trade reasoning and tell timings are our own tactical read, not scraped data.
